what: Pressing the 40px black circle in a screen corner (the panel behind the menu button) first turns it into a pill sideways in place (width only), then 200ms later into a panel downward (height too). Both are .3s (0,0,0,1) center-axis FLIP (translate·scale), so the corners are divided by the scale and look equally rounded throughout. The moment the panel stands, the × turns on in .3s and the menu rows enter from 120px to the right, .2·.3·.4·.5s late, in .4s (0,0,0,1). Pressing ×·Esc·outside pulls the content out at once and the panel folds back into a circle in .3s.

options.wait: Time from becoming a pill to growing into a panel (s), default .2 — 0 goes straight to the panel
options.x: Distance the menu row slides in (px), default 120
options.delay: Time from panel settling to first line (seconds), default .2
options.item: Time for one line to come in (sec), default .4
options.ease: Curve (four numbers or GSAP name), default 0,0,0,1
options.--fx-size · --fx-open-w · --fx-open-h ·: (css variables) collapsed circle size · open panel width · height · corner radius, default 40px · 389px · 429px · half the circle
options.--fx-top · --fx-right · --fx-fill: (CSS variable) position and panel color, default 24px · 24px · ink black
options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Open button (icon) — required. When opened it hides and a × takes its place
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: (if present) content on the panel — turns on once the panel is fully up
options.[data-fx-part=item]: (If any) Menu rows that come in one after another
